subject: ShellPkg/TimeDate: Extract PrintTime() helper
reasons: Function extraction refactor: two duplicated ShellPrintHiiDefaultEx blocks for printing time are replaced by calls to a new PrintTime() helper
The pattern (duplicated time-print block replaced by single call) is present at two sites, but Coccinelle cannot introduce new helper functions or restructure into a new abstraction
While the two call sites share identical structure, the transformation requires generating a new function declaration - beyond Coccinelle's capability
